name: ultimate-research
displayName: Ultimate Research — Unified Autonomous Research & ARS Verification Engine
description: The Ultimate Research Engine: Intercepts search queries with temporal bounds and anti-slop filters, executes Split-Horizon comparisons, performs ARS citation verification, zero-context Elephant-Goldfish adversarial attacks, and Google Research Harness² recursive optimization.
author: Antigravity Engineering / Ultimate Research Contributors

tools.name: deslop_build_query
tools.description: Transforms a raw search query into a clean, operator-budgeted search dork with temporal bounds (default after:2010 before:2023), spam farm exclusions (-site:...), community source routing, and optional dual Split-Horizon compilation (split_horizon=true).

query.description: Raw user or agent search query.

split_horizon.description: When true, compiles parallel Lane A ([HORIZONTE CANÔNICO: PRÉ-2023] routed to Reddit/SO/GitHub/Indie Blogs) and Lane B ([HORIZONTE CONTEMPORÂNEO: PÓS-2023] guarded by blocklist.json + anti-slop filter) plus a Differential & Conflicts analysis.

era.description: Temporal boundary preset when split_horizon is false.

profile.description: Optional curated human community routing profile.

engine.description: Target search engine (determines operator token budget and URL parameters such as udm=14).

tools.name: deslop_split_horizon
tools.description: Executes or audits a Dual Temporal Split-Horizon search confronting [HORIZONTE CANÔNICO: PRÉ-2023] human literature against [HORIZONTE CONTEMPORÂNEO: PÓS-2023] audited recent data, concluding with a [DIFERENCIAL E CONFLITOS] divergence block.

split_horizon.description: Explicit Split-Horizon toggle (enabled by default on this tool).

live.description: When true (async handler), dispatches parallel queries across Pre-2023 and Post-2023 archives.

cutoff_year.description: Temporal boundary year separating Canonical Lane A from Contemporary Lane B.

canonical_results.description: Optional pre-fetched Lane A results to audit and compare offline.

contemporary_results.description: Optional pre-fetched Lane B results to audit and compare offline.

tools.name: deslop_classify_text
tools.description: Scores snippet or webpage text (0.0 to 1.0) for synthetic AI SEO slop using lexical corporate jargon (EN/PT-BR), symmetrical Bold-Colon listicles, paragraph uniformity, sentence burstiness, and technical density.

text.description: Article body or search snippet to inspect.

title.description: Optional page title for SEO year-bait detection.

url.description: Optional page URL to check against known scraper/translation clone blocklists and trusted human domains.

tools.name: deslop_filter_results
tools.description: Filters and re-ranks a batch of raw search results, discarding blocked scraper domains and high-slop snippets while boosting authentic community threads and dense technical posts.

maxSlopScore.description: Maximum allowed slop score (0.0-1.0) before a result is dropped.

tools.name: deslop_verify_citations
tools.description: Verifies factual claims against primary documents with NLI (entailment/neutral/contradiction), temporal freshness check, and citation accuracy.

claim.description: The factual statement or assertion to verify.

evidence.description: The primary source text excerpt or document content.
